thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=BlueMarlin (org_id=bm-578) - 5xx rate spike detected on /v1/generate. Error rate 18% over 2m, traffic increased ~10x. Pager sent to @Maya (oncall). Link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/78321
Maya (oncall): Ack, I'm looking. Pinging SRE + runtime.
Hubert (sre): I'm seeing persistent token bucket hits from the per-org rate limiter. BlueMarlin has a hard QPS limit of 10 and the client retried aggressively. Backpressure cascaded to our model pool -> 500s.
Lina (eng-runtime): If we want the fastest mitigation, we should apply an emergency org override to increase QPS briefly. Scaling pools will take 5-10m and may not help if client retries continue.
Hubert (sre): Agree. Proposal: bump BlueMarlin to 50 QPS for 15m, add 429 -> 503 fallback policy if spike continues.
Jason (cs): I've DM'd the BlueMarlin SRE/engineer — they confirm an A/B rollout test misconfigured client that ramped to prod. They're ready to throttle on their side once we stabilize.
Maya (oncall): I'll apply the emergency override. Command (using admin API):
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/bm-578/overrides"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"qps":50, "duration_mins":15, "reason":"emergency spike - temporary bump for BlueMarlin", "created_by":"Maya"}'
```
Maya (oncall): Applying now.
incident-bot: Override applied by Maya (oncall) — qps=50 duration=15m override_id=ovr-9921.
Hubert (sre): Watching metrics... initial 5xxs dropping. 1m after override: error rate down to 1.2%, p50 latency stable.
Lina (eng-runtime): Confirmed. We still see elevated request volume but no more token-bucket drops. Cost delta noted. I'll add a short-lived route-based caching suggestion for this org to reduce unit tokens while override is active.
Jason (cs): BlueMarlin engineering says they're rolling back the A/B rollout immediately. They asked us to keep the 50 QPS for 15m while they validate. I'll send a notification to their on-call.
Hubert (sre): Setting a 15m reminder to review and rollback if client remains misbehaved. If we still see retries after 10m, switch to a stricter backoff (limited burst=20, sustained=25) and fallback to degraded responses for high-cost models.
Maya (oncall): Got it. Reminder set. Handoff to night oncall at T+20m if still eventing.
Lina (eng-runtime): Logged a temporary mitigation play: /playbooks/mitigations/org-qps-override.md and created ticket INF-4581 for follow-up (investigate client retry patterns + better automatic backpressure).
Hubert (sre): Postmortem owner: Hubert. Will capture timeline, root cause (client rollout), and action items (automated anomaly detection per org, safer default retry guidance).
Maya (oncall): Closing the active pager — system stable. I'll update the incident channel in 15m with final status. :white_check_mark:
